text:
josh: FYI customer reporting huge latency + billing spike. They say they set X-Redwood-Region: us-west-2 but traffic is landing in ap-southeast-1. Sample header they sent shows a leading tab.

marta: ugh. do we trim tabs anywhere in the router? Iirc we only trim space (0x20).

josh: this is the customer's repro (from their code):
```js
// axios example from customer
axios.post(url, data, { headers: { 'X-Redwood-Region': "\t" + process.env.REGION } })
```
They also attached a captured request showing the raw header: `X-Redwood-Region: \tus-west-2` (literal tab). Router log for request id r-9f3b: matched-region: none -> fallback list -> ap-southeast-1. Latency ~450ms vs expected ~30ms.

ryan: can you paste the edge request-headers log for r-9f3b? need to see how it's serialized (percent-encoded vs literal).

josh: edge log snippet: `request_id=r-9f3b incoming_headers={..., \"X-Redwood-Region\": \"\tus-west-2\", ...}`. It looks like literal tab preserved all the way.

marta: OK. diagnosis: our region-routing uses strict equality against canonical region tokens and only trims ASCII SP (0x20) when normalizing. Tabs (0x09) are not normalized per our current parser, so header value doesn't equal \"us-west-2\" and we fall back to region priority.

josh: customer impact: cross-region routing -> higher latency and extra egress charges. They reported a billing delta on their invoice.

ryan: short-term mitigation: we can add a compatibility rule at the edge that runs a lightweight Unicode trim (strip \u0009, \u000A, \u000D, \u0020) for the X-Redwood-Region header before routing. That would be a config flip and small binary change. I'll schedule a canary.

marta: longer-term: normalize header parsing to treat OWS (RFC7230) as allowed and canonicalize region tokens in the router (lowercase + trim all OWS). Also add unit tests and a regression for tab/newline variants. I'll open PR.

josh: customer is on SDK v0.9.4 which doesn't trim. We should notify them to upgrade to the quickfix release once it's out. For now advise manual trimming in their app: `regionHeader = regionHeader.trim()` before setting.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1578 created by josh — label: routing, priority: P2

marta: repro steps we added to the test harness: send header values [\"us-west-2\", \" us-west-2\", \"\tus-west-2\", \"us-west-2\n\"] and assert route stability. Added a failing case for tabs.

ryan: timeline: canary config flip today (15m), rollout to prod if no errors (1h), SDK patch publish tomorrow (cherry-pick + minor bump).

josh: pinging customer with a short explanation and workaround now. will update INC ticket with timeline and billing contact.

marta: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/router/pulls/4520 — normalizes OWS and adds tests. Marking for review.

josh: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll keep customer posted and confirm once canary is green.
